comment: The top bar is arranged on the bar itself. A right click on Keep Blend Mode opens Hide, Move, Show and Arrange, Hide takes it off the bar, a Ctrl drag lifts Help and opens a gap between File and Edit, the release seats it there, and the Elements page opened from the bar's own menu lists the new order. Every press and motion goes through the real input path.
01, a right click on Keep Blend Mode on the second row opens the bar's menu under it.
02, Hide pressed: Keep Blend Mode is gone from the bar and the row closes up.
03, Help pressed with Ctrl held and carried onto File: it hangs faint under the pointer, the titles close up behind it and a gap opens between File and Edit.
04, the release seats Help between File and Edit.
05, Arrange the top bar from the menu on Help opens the Elements page, which lists Help between File and Edit and Keep Blend Mode switched off.
